subject.title: Session files not being cleaned up (disk bloat)

question: Should OpenClaw add a default broad session-artifact retention policy for `.deleted.*`, `.reset.*`, `.tmp`, `.bak.*`, checkpoint, and trajectory artifacts beyond the current partial cleanup paths?
rationale: Current source shows real partial cleanup, but broad automatic deletion changes diagnostics, recovery, and retention semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Scope Broad Cleanup Policy
options.body: Define default and opt-out behavior for each artifact class before queuing a comprehensive fix.

options.title: Land Narrow Reporting First
options.body: Treat the open deleted/reset reporting PR as the immediate fix and keep this issue open for remaining artifact classes.

options.title: Split By Artifact Class
options.body: Move each remaining suffix or sidecar class to a narrower canonical issue with its own safety proof.

recommendation.title: Scope Broad Cleanup Policy
recommendation.body: Define default and opt-out behavior for each artifact class before queuing a comprehensive fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the sessions cleanup UX and maintenance controls that the broad cleanup policy would extend.
